items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: Well, my cousin, Bonnie Big, who's now with Louis Armstrong, he and I came up together almost like brothers.

ctx.x: I know Natty said he was raised that way.

On French, that's right. And I still talk French now. And then when someone, when I can talk with someone. So the first lesson I had at Nelson Jean's house, he was a great friend of the family, but he liked to take a drink of wine. So I went on my first lesson. And then, while he told me to get, had an old cornet that I bought somewhere. I don't know where it was. And anyhow, my daddy found it for me, I believe. And I was too young to remember. He wanted me to learn how to clean the horn. So I decided to clean…
We talked to one of the brothers of the old men. There was an old Lorenzo and a Louis Teo, Papa Teo.
